scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:ios-web && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath artifacts/ios-build -scmProvider system CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive:unsigned: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath artifacts/FitnessTracker.xcarchive -derivedDataPath artifacts/ios-build -scmProvider system CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive
